message.content: {"action":"increase_precision","reason":"Both evaluated LUT/linear designs miss the 8-LSB quality target, so quality must improve. Increasing precision is the only available action with a legal unvisited neighbor, and the prior increase from 12 to 14 phase bits raised area by only ~13.5%, suggesting another precision step may reach the quality threshold without excessive area growth."}
